title: MINOR / Watchface not centered

comments.body:
Feature request : Same watchface in xDrip has the date also ;)

![screen.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/185797492-9ff42437-c319-430a-9cf2-76fc23ceecea.png)

The date is often missing from AAPS faces (I didn't test them all ...)

Most watch faces where designed for square watches. Some of the round watches are an afterthought.
I'll review them to see if I can fix it. Though making it scale across all shapes and size a lot of work
Fossil smartwatch's re-positon the watchface each minute and protect the watch for burn-in effects.  When you going in active mode, all is centered correctly on my Fossil  carlyle (Gen5).
That's not the case on my Fossil. Other AAPS and xDrip faces are centered and don't move either.
